answer: Agents could gate high-value actions on a slowly earned, stake-backed reputation: an account must complete useful tasks, have results checked by independent peers, and keep a bond that is slashed if its work is fraudulent. Copying an identity does not copy its history or stake, so a sybil operator must fund many accounts and make each one earn trust through verified work. Like a voyage across an ocean before tending an orchard, that takes time and capital, while colluding accounts risk losing their bonds.
